metadata.title: SolidWorks CAD Sheet Metal Operations — Sheet metal authoring layer
metadata.description: Parameter catalog for the SolidWorks CAD sheet metal authoring layer. Sheet metal is a specialized part-modeling environment where every feature carries an implicit flat-pattern projection through K-factor / bend allowance / bend deduction calculations. Catalog covers BASE_FLANGE_TAB (the foundational sheet metal feature), 6 flange creators (EDGE_FLANGE / MITER_FLANGE / TAB / SWEPT_FLANGE / LOFTED_BEND / SKETCHED_BEND), 5 modify ops (HEM / JOG / CROSS_BREAK / CORNER_RELIEF / CLOSED_CORNER), 4 form features (GUSSET / VENT / FORMING_TOOL / RIP), 4 bend authoring + flat-pattern ops (UNFOLD / FOLD / FLATTEN / NO_BEND_REGION), and 2 sheet metal parameter / bend table editors (SHEET_METAL_PARAMS / BEND_TABLE_ATTACH). 21 operations / 152 parameters total. Bindings target IFeatureManager.InsertSheetMetalBaseFlange2 / InsertSheetMetalEdgeFlange3 / InsertSheetMetalMiterFlange / InsertSheetMetalHem / InsertSheetMetalJog2 / InsertCornerRelief / InsertSheetMetalGusset / InsertSheetMetalVent / InsertFormToolFromCatalog / InsertSheetMetalRip / InsertSheetMetalUnfold / InsertSheetMetalFold / IModelDoc2.SheetMetalFlatten — the canonical SolidWorks 2024 sheet metal authoring API.
metadata.source: SolidWorks 2024 API Help — Sheet Metal; SolidWorks API Reference — IFeatureManager (sheet metal methods); SolidWorks 2024 Sheet Metal toolbar; ASME Y14.41 (3D Annotated Models); industry K-factor / bend allowance practice (e.g. Diehl tooling tables)

commonTabs.description: Standard parameter tabs across SolidWorks sheet metal operations

BASE_FLANGE_TAB.description: Base flange/tab — the foundational sheet metal feature. Defines sheet thickness, default bend radius, K-factor (or bend allowance / bend deduction / bend table), and default auto-relief style for the entire part. Subsequent flanges/bends inherit these defaults unless overridden.

parameters.name: Profile Sketch
parameters.description: Closed sketch defining the base flange shape

parameters.name: Gauge Table Path
parameters.description: Required when Use Gauge Table = true

parameters.name: K-Factor
parameters.description: Required when Bend Allowance Type = k_factor

parameters.name: Relief Ratio
parameters.description: Relief size as multiple of thickness

EDGE_FLANGE.description: Edge flange — add a flange perpendicular to a selected edge. Length End Condition controls termination (blind / up_to_vertex / up_to_edge / up_to_surface / offset_from_surface). Position Mode controls flange placement relative to the parent edge (material_inside / material_outside / bend_outside / bend_centered / bend_from_virtual_sharp).

parameters.name: Source Edge
parameters.description: Edge to attach flange to

parameters.name: Length
parameters.description: Required when Length End Condition = blind

parameters.name: Custom Bend Radius
parameters.description: Used when Override Bend Radius = true

parameters.name: Trim Side Bends
parameters.description: Auto-trim conflicting adjacent bends

parameters.name: Edit Flange Profile
parameters.description: Open profile sketch for custom shape

MITER_FLANGE.description: Miter flange — propagates a profile sketch along multiple connected edges, creating mitered corners automatically. Gap controls the corner gap; Continuous Propagation drives the flange across all tangent edges from the seed.

parameters.name: Profile Sketch
parameters.description: Open profile sketch perpendicular to first edge

parameters.name: Seed Edges
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of edges to propagate along

parameters.name: Continuous Propagation
parameters.description: Auto-extend across tangent edges

parameters.name: Gap
parameters.description: Corner gap distance

parameters.name: Start Trim
parameters.description: Trim flange start to source edge

TAB.description: Tab feature — extrudes a closed sketch on an existing flange face into a coplanar tab (no bend). Used for raised pads, mounting bosses, and stiffening features.

parameters.name: Profile Sketch
parameters.description: Closed sketch on a flange face

parameters.name: Sketch Plane
parameters.description: Flange face containing the sketch

parameters.name: Link To Thickness
parameters.description: Tab thickness follows part thickness parameter

SWEPT_FLANGE.description: Swept flange — sweeps a profile along a path with sheet metal semantics (bend allowance + flat pattern). Handles curved sheet metal flanges that cannot be made by edge flange (e.g. spiral, helix, curved-edge flanges).

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: Sketch / edge / curve to sweep along

LOFTED_BEND.description: Lofted bend — sheet metal feature transitioning between two profile sketches (e.g. round-to-rectangle transition). Forming Method selects bend (preserves manufacturable bend lines) vs formed (continuous deformation, may not be foldable).

parameters.name: Number of Bend Lines
parameters.description: Used when Forming Method = bend

SKETCHED_BEND.description: Sketched bend — bend a flat sheet metal face along a sketched line. Bend Position controls how the bend is placed relative to the sketch line (bend_centerline / material_inside / material_outside / bend_outside).

parameters.name: Bend Line Sketch
parameters.description: Sketch containing one or more lines on a flat face

parameters.name: Fixed Face
parameters.description: Face that remains stationary during bending

HEM.description: Hem — fold an edge back on itself for safety, stiffness, or joining. Hem Type selects closed (zero gap) / open (rolled with gap) / tear-drop / rolled. Gap controls the open hem clearance.

parameters.name: Edges To Hem
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of edges

parameters.name: Gap Distance
parameters.description: Used when Hem Type = open / rolled

parameters.name: Hem Bend Radius
parameters.description: Override default bend radius for the hem itself

JOG.description: Jog — sheet metal step (Z-bend) using a sketched line as the centerline. Creates two parallel bends with a flat between them at a step offset from the parent face.

parameters.name: Bend Line Sketch
parameters.description: Sketch with a single line on a flat face

CROSS_BREAK.description: Cross break — diagonal stiffening rib formed by partial bends across a flat face. Improves panel stiffness without adding material. Cross-break angle is typically 0.5-2 degrees (cosmetic / structural deformation, not a true bend).

CORNER_RELIEF.description: Corner relief — controlled material removal at multi-bend corners to prevent tearing. Relief Type selects rectangular / obround / round / tear. Gap controls relief opening size.
CORNER_RELIEF.solidworks_command: Insert > Sheet Metal > Corner > Corner Relief

parameters.name: Corner Vertices
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of corner vertex IDs

parameters.name: Add Tangent Edges
parameters.description: Smooth-blend the relief edges

CLOSED_CORNER.description: Closed corner — fill the gap at a sheet metal corner with overlap, butt, or underlap. Used to complete enclosures where bent flanges meet.

parameters.name: Faces To Extend
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of corner faces

parameters.name: Overlap Ratio
parameters.description: 0..1 overlap fraction (Corner Type = overlap / underlap)

parameters.name: Butt Gap
parameters.description: Gap between butt-corner faces

parameters.name: Open Bend Region
parameters.description: Keep bend region open (no closure across bend)

parameters.name: Coplanar Faces
parameters.description: Force closure to coplanar faces only

GUSSET.description: Gusset — internal stiffening rib spanning two sheet metal faces across a bend. Form Method selects flat (formed-from-flat-stock) vs round (rolled). Per ANSI sheet metal practice typically used at right-angle bends to prevent flange deflection.

parameters.name: Indent Thickness
parameters.description: Thickness for the gusset rib material

parameters.name: Position Reference Plane
parameters.description: Optional reference for gusset placement

VENT.description: Vent feature — ventilation cutout pattern (louvers / openings) on a sheet metal face. Pattern Style selects from circular / rectangular / louver patterns; Spar Width controls connector ribs.

parameters.name: Boundary Sketch
parameters.description: Closed sketch defining the vent area

parameters.name: Rib Width
parameters.description: Spar width between vent openings

FORMING_TOOL.description: Forming tool — apply a punch / lance / louver / extruded-flange form from the SolidWorks Forming Tools library to a sheet metal face. Library Path selects from Toolbox or custom forming-tool catalog.

parameters.name: Forming Tool Path
parameters.description: Path to .sldftp form-tool file

parameters.name: Position Sketch
parameters.description: Sketch points for tool instances

parameters.name: Flip Tool
parameters.description: Apply tool to opposite face direction

parameters.name: Link To Tool File
parameters.description: Maintain external link to tool definition

RIP.description: Rip — cut a continuous edge in a multi-body part to allow it to be unfolded as a single sheet. Required step when converting an imported solid into editable sheet metal.

parameters.name: Edges To Rip
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of edges

parameters.name: Make Sheet Metal
parameters.description: Auto-convert ripped body to sheet metal feature

parameters.name: Auto-Detect Bends
parameters.description: Auto-create bend features at edges around the rip

UNFOLD.description: Unfold one or more bends — temporarily flatten selected bends so additional features (cuts, holes, slots) can be authored on the resulting flat face. Pair with FOLD to restore the bent state after editing.

parameters.name: Fixed Face
parameters.description: Face that stays in place during unfold

parameters.name: Bends To Unfold
parameters.description: Comma-separated bend feature names, or 'all'

parameters.name: Collect All Bends
parameters.description: Auto-include every bend in the part

parameters.name: Suppress Process Bends
parameters.description: Suppress process bends (forming-tool bends) during unfold

FOLD.description: Fold previously unfolded bends — restore bent state. Used after UNFOLD + cut-extrude operations to bring the part back to its formed configuration.

parameters.name: Bends To Fold
parameters.description: Comma-separated bend feature names, or 'all'

FLATTEN.description: Flatten — toggle the flat pattern view (entire part unfolded for laser/punch/waterjet output). Distinct from UNFOLD (per-bend, mid-design) — FLATTEN is the final flat-pattern derived feature.
FLATTEN.solidworks_command: Insert > Sheet Metal > Flatten / View > Flat Pattern

parameters.name: Override Fixed Face
parameters.description: Used when Override Default Fixed Face = true

parameters.name: Show Bounding Box
parameters.description: Display bounding rectangle (stock size estimation)

NO_BEND_REGION.description: No-bend region — mark a region of a flange that should NOT participate in bending operations. Used to preserve features (holes, embossed text) that cross a planned bend line and would otherwise distort.
NO_BEND_REGION.solidworks_command: Insert > Sheet Metal > No Bend Region

parameters.name: Boundary Sketch
parameters.description: Closed sketch defining the no-bend zone

SHEET_METAL_PARAMS.description: Edit global sheet metal parameters (thickness / default bend radius / K-factor / bend tables / gauge tables). Distinct from BASE_FLANGE_TAB: this op edits parameters AFTER the base flange exists.

BEND_TABLE_ATTACH.description: Attach a bend table or bend deduction table to the part. Bend tables map (gauge, bend_radius, bend_angle) tuples to specific bend allowances measured from physical tooling — preferred over K-factor when shop has empirical data.

parameters.name: Table Path
parameters.description: Path to .btl or .xls bend table

parameters.name: Material Override
parameters.description: Optional material name to scope the table to

parameters.name: Replace Existing
parameters.description: Replace previously attached table of same type

parameters.name: Validate Bounds
parameters.description: Warn when current bend params fall outside table range
